title: RegGuard Plugin Manifest
description: Canonical registry of every capability the application exposes. The manifest is the single source of truth for what the app can do; the audit script verifies the manifest against the codebase and reports drift.

version.description: Manifest schema version (semver). Bump on breaking schema changes.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last manifest edit.

key.description: Stable identifier. Must match the ViewKey / route segment used in code.

description.description: One-line explanation of what this plugin does.

category.description: Top-level grouping. Should match nav zone structure.

status.description: Explicit absence state. ready = fully working and audited; in_progress = file exists, partially implemented; planned = manifest entry only, no code; deprecated = explicitly retired; not_implemented = no code and no current plan to build (shows 404-style page).

owner.description: Person or team responsible. Optional but recommended.

expectedDelivery.description: For in_progress / planned only. ISO date.

implementation.description: References to where this plugin lives in the codebase. Used by the audit script to detect drift.

component.description: Path to the React component file, relative to repo root. e.g. src/components/forms/FormInstanceView.tsx

viewKey.description: The ViewKey string used in page.tsx switch statement, if this is a UI plugin.

apiRoute.description: API route path, e.g. /api/forms. Used to verify the endpoint exists.

staticData.description: Path to static JSON data file used in static-build mode, e.g. public/data/forms/instances.json

capabilities.description: Granular capability list. Each entry is individually auditable. e.g. ['create-instance', 'run-autofill', 'view-provenance']

audit.description: Per-plugin verification criteria. The audit script uses these to determine pass/fail.

minContentLength.description: Minimum rendered text length (chars) expected on the page. Default 200.

expectedHeading.description: Substring expected in the page's main heading. Case-insensitive.

requiresLiveRuntime.description: If true, this plugin only fully works on the dev server (needs DB / API). Static build will show a degraded but non-empty state. Default false.

requiresBackButton.description: If true, the audit verifies a Back button is present on this page. Default true for all non-dashboard pages.

dependencies.description: Keys of other plugins this one depends on. Audit will warn if a dependency is not ready.
